newsitem.title: USA: Bridgeport says Q2 sales below year ago.
newsitem.headline: Bridgeport says Q2 sales below year ago.

text.p: Bridgeport Machines Inc said on Monday it expected sales for the fiscal 1998 second quarter to come in below figures reported for the year-ago period, due to a softening in European markets for its metal cutting machine tools.

"Conditions in Europe will remain difficult over the near- term," said Bridgeport chief executive Dan Griffith. In addition, Griffith said the lower projected sales would result in "earnings that may only be breakeven." The company posted first quarter earnings of $1.5 million, or $0.26 per share, compared with $2.7 million, or $0.47 per share, in the first quarter of 1997.
